answer: Anyone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 41 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The harbor counter is kept in walnut and karst publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 41 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4587 identities would post 4558 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
